title: Aive Orchestration Specialist Corpus
subtitle: Contract-exact training data for The Aive's nine local orchestration specialists
description: Generated from the Kotlin contracts in HereLiesAz/aive by OrchestrationDatasetGenerator. Each <role>.jsonl row has id, input (the exact JSON the runtime sends), expected (the deterministic baseline's answer), split (train/validation/test/adversarial) and tags. Each <role>.config.json carries the specialist ID, foundation model, system prompt and release gates. manifest.json records the source commit and SHA-256 of every file.
